name: Interior
description: Represents the interior of an object.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Returns or sets the primary color of the object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the color of the interior. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: InvertIfNegative
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word inverts the pattern in the object when it corresponds to a negative number. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Pattern
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value, containing an XlPattern constant, that represents the interior pattern.

properties.name: PatternColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the color of the interior pattern as an RGB value. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: PatternColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the color of the interior pattern as an index into the current color palette, or as one of the following XlColorIndex constants: xlColorIndexAutomatic or xlColorIndexNone. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft PowerPoint application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.
